recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-23710 unless a future tooling/build review separately decides to expose or clean up internal invariant short labels.
issue_request: FHIR-23710 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested updating the Timing.repeat.timeOfDay comment to say: "If there's a timeOfDay, there cannot be a when, or vice versa." The issue corrected older wording that incorrectly said timeOfDay could not be used with frequency or period.
initial_application: The R5 MnM commit 5cbc14c7d0f361941099bf72066b75c3f74f6d4f explicitly listed FHIR-23710 and changed source/datatypes/timing.xml from the old frequency/period prohibition to the approved timeOfDay/when mutual-exclusion wording. The issue therefore appears to have been applied historically in the authoritative Timing datatype spreadsheet.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini routes Timing through the active datatypes build area, and source/datatypes/timing.xml is the authoritative Timing source. The current comment and tim-10 human/expression match FHIR-23710. A combined-branch FHIR-25289 reconciliation commit, 542e45405a17e048b338101140592af45aae9dcd, already clarified the related residual daily-inference wording while citing FHIR-23710 as same-change-family evidence. A stale internal invariant short label still mentions frequency/period, but the generated-facing human constraint and expression are correct and the old prohibition was not found in current source output outside historical release snapshots.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The seed was decided with an empty audit commit because the requested current-spec semantics are already present and a duplicate source edit would not improve the built specification.
